summary: The change is limited to deterministic in-process engine logic (src/engine/hand.ts liveLevels/gather/forceFold, src/engine/invariants.ts checks), new seeded tests, docs, and a test-only Playwright init script that counts Worker postMessage/replies. It adds no trust boundary, input parsing, storage format, dependency, secret, or network/file/shell sink. forceFold is reached only from the app's own Leave-table flow with a seat number the engine already validates (RangeError guards unchanged). The new loops are O(actions x seats) over a bounded hand record, so there is no resource-exhaustion path. Product shuffle and bot randomness are untouched. The Worker.prototype patch is installed only through page.addInitScript in e2e/leave-mid-hand.spec.ts and never ships. No findings.
